title: Research Engineer / Scientist
description:
About Avra

Avra is a deep tech data intelligence platform powered by foundational AI that translates the complexity of SMEs into strategic decisions for large enterprises. We develop our own foundational models from the ground up—without relying on third-party solutions—to deliver innovative insights that empower some of the leading banks and fintechs across Latin America. Founded in 2024 by Bruno Alano (ex-OpenAI) and Viviane Meister, our team brings together expertise from NVIDIA, Palantir, Google, and more to drive real impact.

About the Role

In this role, you will define and execute an applied research agenda at the frontier of AI. You will build and optimize our entire ML pipeline—from data collection and preparation to training, evaluation, and production monitoring—while developing novel architectures that push the boundaries of what's possible. You'll fine-tune our foundational models for diverse client applications, and work on innovative solutions involving massive datasets and cutting-edge research.

Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to work with global AI advisors who are leaders in research worldwide, and join a team that was selected by AWS as one of the three model builders in LATAM.

Responsibilities

  • Innovative Model Architecture: Design, implement, and refine new machine learning and deep learning architectures by staying current with academic research and reading relevant papers daily.

  • End-to-End Pipeline Management: Build, test, and monitor robust data pipelines and training processes, ensuring scalability and reliability in production environments.

  • Model Fine-Tuning & Customization: Adapt and optimize our foundational models for various client needs, leveraging experimentation and hyperparameter tuning platforms.

  • Application Development: Develop diverse AI-driven applications that integrate seamlessly with our platform, translating research insights into real-world solutions.

  • Product Integration: Collaborate with engineering and product teams to transform complex business challenges into technical solutions that harness the power of frontier research.

  • Technical Leadership: Take full technical ownership of research projects, making strategic decisions that directly influence the evolution of our products.

You Stand Out If

  • You have deep, hands-on experience with PyTorch or similar deep learning frameworks.

  • You are passionate about frontier research, routinely exploring academic literature to drive innovation.

  • You have a track record of working with complex data pipelines and large-scale machine learning systems.

  • You’re experienced in experimenting with and fine-tuning models using advanced hyperparameter tuning platforms.

  • Experience with graph-based models is a plus.

  • You thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional team environment and are comfortable taking full responsibility for your projects.

Qualifications

  • Experience: At least 5 years in designing, implementing, and monitoring impactful machine learning models.

  • Academic Background: Bachelor’s degree (preferably with a specialization or Master’s) in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Technical Proficiency: Extensive experience with modern deep learning frameworks (preferably PyTorch) and a solid understanding of state-of-the-art modeling techniques.

  • Research Mindset: Strong ability to design experiments, evaluate model performance, and implement algorithmic improvements based on the latest research.

  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and experience working in agile, cross-functional teams.

Differentiators

  • Prior experience with distributed systems and processing large volumes of data.

  • Exposure to graph-based models and related technologies.

  • Active involvement in applied AI research, including publications or contributions to the research community.

  • Familiarity with MLOps practices for model deployment and production integration.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary, equity participation, and full transparency in our compensation package.

  • Autonomy and Impact: Work directly with our founders and technical leadership, with the freedom to shape the direction of groundbreaking research.

  • Cutting-Edge Environment: Engage in frontier research, working with huge amounts of data and developing models that have real-world impact across diverse applications.

  • Global Expertise: Benefit from the guidance of global AI advisors and join a team recognized by AWS as one of the three model builders in LATAM.

  • Flexible Culture: Enjoy 100% remote work with access to our São Paulo office, unlimited vacation, and a comprehensive benefits package including a national health plan and extended parental leave.

If you’re driven by a passion for innovative research and eager to push the limits of AI while working with massive datasets and groundbreaking architectures, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Data Technical Account Manager  - Funds
description:
At Bloomberg, our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we’re responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately.

Bloomberg’s Funds Data team is looking for a technical account manager to join its growing team in São Paulo, Brazil. There are around half a million funds in the market, each with various structures and characteristics, that the team supports from creation. The Funds team works with content partners such as asset managers, exchanges, and regulatory bodies to ensure that the funds markets in Latin America are represented on the Bloomberg Terminal and related products. As part of the team, you’ll work alongside a Team Leader and other technical account managers to support the region, enhance onboarding workflows and procedures, and manage fund profiles throughout their launch and investing period. This includes configuring ETL pipelines, communicating with contributors to ensure proper data ingestion from fund inception, and contributing business rules and quality workflows to ensure high data accuracy. You will also maintain and grow your knowledge of funds data processes and client engagement.

Responsibilities include:

  • Acquiring, updating, and maintaining high-quality funds data using various internal systems, proprietary software, and automation knowledge.
  • Collaborating with subject matter experts to enrich funds data using technical tools.
  • Establishing and maintaining relationships with internal departments and external clients.
  • Maintaining a working knowledge of the fund data space by processing data for your assigned coverage and answering client questions.
  • Working with other groups such as Product, Sales, News, and Engineering to develop and enhance product databases and functionalities.
  • Configuring workflows in a production environment using Bloomberg’s data processing technologies.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline.
  • 2+ years of experience as a data analyst or in the asset management/finance industry.
  • Excellent written communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects.
  • A growing interest in data and data-driven actions.
  • Fluent English language skills.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with the Funds Market, sales roles, or key concepts related to these products.
  • Willingness to collaborate and mentor others.
  • Proficiency with Git, SQL, and Python.
  • Relevant certifications such as CFA or CAIA.

About the Data Department:

The Data Department works with a variety of data sets, each managed by dedicated teams focused on processing, developing, and ensuring quality for our customers. Data is fundamental to Bloomberg's operations, supporting everything from data sourcing and processing to product development in collaboration with engineers and decision-makers. The department offers opportunities to develop diverse skills and is integral to all aspects of Bloomberg’s organization.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 90.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE O BANCO DE TALENTOS

A Gurilândia é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Este é um banco de talentos para Professores de Matemática. Se você ama trabalhar com essa disciplina, se comunica de forma clara e é uma pessoa proativa, não deixe de enviar seu currículo!

Como nosso Professor(a) de Matemática, você cumpriria as seguintes atividades:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas da matéria alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Para se inscrever você irá precisar ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Matemática.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for a Salesforce Engineer to join our team on a contract basis to develop and enhance a Salesforce application focused on customer data aggregation in the luxury automotive sector . This role requires deep technical expertise in Salesforce development and integration, strong problem-solving abilities, and a keen eye for detail.

You will work closely with business analysts and stakeholders to deliver scalable and high-performance Salesforce solutions that improve customer data management and reporting efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and customize Salesforce applications to support customer data aggregation and management.

  • Optimize workflows and automation using Process Builder, Flow, and related tools.
  • Build reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
  • Conduct testing, debugging, and deployment of Salesforce components.
  • Troubleshoot issues and ensure high system performance and data security.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Salesforce Engineer or Developer , with a strong portfolio.
  • Proficiency in Apex , Visualforce , and Lightning Web Components (LWC) .
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems (REST/SOAP APIs, MuleSoft, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data models , workflows, and automation tools.
  • Familiarity with CRM processes and customer data management.
  • Experience in the automotive or luxury goods industry is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Salesforce certifications (Developer, Platform App Builder) are preferred.

Benefits & Perks:

title: Prefeitura distribui cobertores para pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social
description:
Prefeitura distribui cobertores para pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social

Prefeito Marçal Filho participa da primeira distribuição de cobertores para pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social em Dourados. Foto: A. Frota

Com a previsão climática apontando frio intenso ainda nesta semana na região Sul de Mato Grosso do Sul, a Prefeitura de Dourados se antecipou à “virada de tempo” e entregou, na noite desta segunda-feira (26), em vários pontos da cidade, cobertores para pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social. Ao mesmo tempo em que distribui cobertores, a Prefeitura de Dourados também realiza nesta quarta-feira (28), no CRAS Vila Vargas, o brechó solidário com roupas doadas na campanha do agasalho que está sendo coordenada pela Secretaria Municipal de Assistência Social.

A distribuição de cobertores, também coordenada pela Secretaria Municipal de Assistência Social, em ação conjunta com a Guarda Municipal, contou com participação do prefeito Marçal Filho, que destacou a iniciativa e o objetivo de aquecer as pessoas expostas às baixas temperaturas. “Juntamente a minha equipe nos antecipamos à chegada do frio e viemos trazer mais alento para quem precisa”, disse o prefeito.

O primeiro grupo de pessoas beneficiadas com a entrega dos cobertores estava concentrado na Praça Paraguaia, no Jardim Itália, onde cerca de 10 vulneráveis receberam o agasalho. Na sequência, a equipe e o prefeito foram na região do Residencial Guassu, onde localizaram uma família residindo em um barraco de plástico preto e totalmente exposta ao frio. Eles também receberam cobertores. “Na sequência, as viaturas atenderam pessoas em situação de rua na Praça do Cinquentenário e nas imediações do Terminal Rodoviário de Dourados”, explica Jamil da Costa Matos, comandante da Guarda Municipal de Dourados.

A secretária de Assistência Social, Shirley Flores Zarpelon, disse que a distribuição de cobertores para pessoas em situação de rua seguirá nos próximos dias, afim de proteger essa população vulnerável nos dias mais gelados do inverno que se aproxima. A Guarda Municipal participará da entrega dos cobertores no município, sobretudo identificando os locais onde estão as pessoas em situação de rua e dando suporte às equipes da assistência social.

A ação ocorrerá conforme a demanda e, no primeiro momento, os agentes da Prefeitura de Dourados oferecerão transporte até a Casa da Acolhida. “Aqueles que não quiserem ir para o abrigo, vão receber os cobertores para se protegerem do frio”, explica a secretária. Shirley Zarpelon anunciou ainda que a Assistência Social oferece serviço de pernoite na Casa da Acolhida e fica a critério do cidadão em situação de rua aceitar ou não o acolhimento.

O inverno começa oficialmente no dia 20 de junho, no entanto, a previsão aponta que as temperaturas em Dourados devem despencar da média dos 30 graus para 7 graus já nesta quinta-feira (29). “Determinei tanto à Guarda Municipal quanto à Secretaria Municipal de Assistência Social que mantenham a vigilância constante para identificar e assistir as pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social”, enfatiza o prefeito Marçal Filho.

Ao mesmo tempo em que atende as pessoas vulneráveis, a Prefeitura de Dourados continua com a Campanha do Agasalho 2025, que neste ano tem o tema “Cuidando com Amor e Aquecendo Vidas”. A campanha foi lançada no CRAS do Parque do Lago II, onde serão atendidas famílias/indivíduos que vivem em situação de vulnerabilidade e risco social referenciados no território daquela unidade.

Os demais CRAS também estão arrecadando itens de inverno para doações e organizando as destinações. A entrega dos agasalhos será feita por meio de “Brechós Solidários”, com toda organização das doações por tamanho infantil e adulto, masculino/feminino, sendo publicizado através da Prefeitura e mídias, mostrando para comunidade douradense a importância da solidariedade e o bem humanitário para a população carente.

Caixas para coletas de doações estão disponibilizadas em vários pontos da cidade. Em cada unidade parceira das Secretarias e da Prefeitura e locais privados que aceitaram a parceria, foi instalada uma caixa personalizada para a coleta dos artigos de inverno, como agasalhos, sapatos, toucas, cobertores, meias, mantas, entre outros. Os itens podem ser novos ou usados, desde que em bom estado.

A secretária Shirley Flores Zarpelon explica que a iniciativa da campanha atende recomendação do prefeito Marçal Filho e busca contemplar o maior número de famílias e/ou pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade e risco social no período de inverno que se aproxima. “Doar agasalho é um ato de amor”, enfatiza. “Esperamos contar com a solidariedade da população douradense e das empresas para que nenhuma pessoa passe frio em Dourados”, finaliza.

Sobre a Congregação

A Congregação das Irmãs de Santa Marcelina foi fundada pelo Beato Luigi Biraghi em 1838, na Itália, motivado pelos valores éticos, humanitários e cristãos, por meio do amor e do exemplo educador. As Irmãs realizam sua missão nos continentes: americano, europeu e africano, presentes na Albânia, Benin, Brasil, Canadá, Inglaterra, Itália, México e Suíça. No Brasil, atuam em nove estados: Bahia, Brasília, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Santa Catarina, São Paulo e Tocantins.

Há mais de 60 anos, a Congregação é responsável pelo Santa Marcelina Saúde composto pela rede de 7 hospitais (Porto Velho-RO, Sapezal-MT, Itaquaquecetuba-SP, Cidade Tiradentes-SP, Itaim Paulista-SP, Itaquera-SP e São Bernardo do Campo-SP) e mais de 140 serviços de Atenção Primária à Saúde localizados na região leste do município de São Paulo. Tornou-se uma importante referência na prestação de serviços e pela atuação nos diferentes níveis de atenção à saúde, por meio do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), Convênios e Particulares.

SOBRE A CAPCO

Somos uma consultoria global de tecnologia e gestão, especializada em transformação digital no setor de serviços financeiros e de energia. Temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Trabalhamos com mais de 100 grandes organizações ao redor do mundo, entregando soluções inovadoras e impulsionando iniciativas digitais em áreas como bancos, pagamentos, mercados de capitais, gestão de ativos, seguros e até o setor de energia. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

Estamos procurando um(a) Engenheiro(a) senior de automação de QA/QA. Como engenheiro(a) sênior de automação de QA/QA na Capco, você liderará o fornecimento de soluções de software de alta qualidade para nossos clientes de serviços financeiros. Combinando conhecimento técnico com recursos de liderança, você projetará e implementará estruturas de teste robustas, orientará os membros da equipe e garantirá os mais altos padrões de qualidade em todo o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software.

Essa função é ideal para um(a) profissional de controle de qualidade experiente com paixão por automação, atenção aos detalhes e mentalidade colaborativa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter estruturas abrangentes de automação de testes, impulsionando a eficiência e a consistência no processo de controle de qualidade.

  • Impulsionar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, otimizando processos, ferramentas e metodologias de controle de qualidade.
  • Defender uma cultura de qualidade identificando riscos, defendendo melhorias de teste e mantendo-se à frente das tendências do setor em controle de qualidade e automação.

Requisitos:

Habilidades técnicas:

  • Experiência em testes de aplicativos da web (incluindo sites móveis responsivos) - em particular, plataformas de vendas B2B e B2B2C
  • Experiência em funções de automação de QA/QA, com foco na construção e dimensionamento de estruturas de automação de teste.
  • Experiência em ferramentas de automação como Selenium, Cypress, Playwright ou equivalente.
  • Forte proficiência em linguagens de script e programação, incluindo JavaScript, Python ou Java.
  • Capacidade comprovada de integrar automação com pipelines de CI/CD usando Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD ou ferramentas semelhantes.
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de nuvem AWS e experiência em testes em ambientes distribuídos.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de conteinerização como Docker e plataformas de orquestração como Kubernetes.

Habilidades interpessoais:

  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas excepcionais, com a capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de qualidade.
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança e orientação, com foco em promover a colaboração e o crescimento dentro das equipes de controle de qualidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais, com capacidade de apresentar insights técnicos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Uma mentalidade proativa, sempre buscando oportunidades para melhorar a qualidade e os processos de teste.

Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Inglês fluente / proficiente
  • Experiência no domínio de serviços financeiros, com compreensão de seus requisitos exclusivos de conformidade e segurança.
  • Familiaridade com estruturas de escalonamento ágil como SAFe ou LeSS

POR QUE CAPCO:

Juntar-se à Capco significa ingressar em uma organização comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo onde você é incentivado a #BeYourselfAtWork (Ser Você Mesmo no Trabalho). Celebramos a individualidade e reconhecemos que a diversidade e a inclusão, em todas as formas, são fundamentais para o sucesso. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

We are seeking an experienced HSEQ Manager with a strong background in environmental and social risk management to lead the implementation of the Integrated Management System (IMS) on a large-scale infrastructure project in Angola . This role will be instrumental in ensuring full compliance with international standards and in fostering a proactive culture of safety, environmental protection, quality, and social performance across all project phases.

This position is based in Angola and will contribute to the promotion of a proactive HSEQ culture aligned with international standards and best practices.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Integrated Management System (IMS) in alignment with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
  • Ensure full compliance with national legislation and international frameworks (IFC Performance Standards, Equator Principles, and World Bank EHS Guidelines).
  • Oversee the application of environmental and social mitigation measures, including biodiversity management, stakeholder engagement, and grievance mechanisms.
  • Guide and mentor the HSEQ team, ensuring alignment with project goals, clear task allocation, and staff development.
  • Lead incident investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Coordinate stakeholder and community engagement in close collaboration with the social performance team.
  • Ensure quality assurance in construction activities through regular inspections, audits, and follow-up on non-conformities.
  • Deliver training and awareness sessions on HSEQ and ESG-related topics across all levels of the project team

Key Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Social Sciences, Occupational Health & Safety, or related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in HSEQ roles with strong emphasis on environmental and social compliance, preferably in infrastructure or EPC projects.
  • Proven track record implementing IFC Performance Standards.
  • Strong knowledge of international IMS standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
  • Demonstrated experience working in multi-stakeholder environments, including engagement with local communities and government entities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and analytical skills.
  • Experience working in African countries is considered an asset.
  • Languages : Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory. Spanish is considered an asset.

title: Automation Solution Architect (BY+EWM)
description:
Automation Solution Architect (BY+EWM)

You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground-breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

In this role, you will:

  • Be responsible for architecting solutions for our warehouse automation that include integrating multiple WMS solutions (BY, SAP EWM, SAP ERP) with integration platforms, WES and WCS providers that meet the needs of some of the most complex business functions in Kimberly Clark.
  • Bring deep knowledge of WMS solutions like Blue Yonder and SAP EWM, and vast experience on how best it can be leveraged to meet operational needs whilst minimizing technical complexity.
  • Involved in leading delivery of most complex client technical projects.
  • Support in the definition of business and technical requirements to ensure strategies and solutions are aligned with business needs.
  • Design high quality end-to-end solutions to meet the business needs both now and in the future by ensuring solutions are fit for purpose, scalable, resilient and secure.
  • Define detailed specifications according to which solutions are defined, managed, and delivered.
  • Design and oversee the design, configuration and build of the WMS solution and its integration with other interconnected systems.
  • Ensure design practices, artefacts and processes are in line with leading industry patterns and practices.
  • Provide technical governance and assurance for proposed solutions throughout the delivery life cycle.
  • Identify and mitigate existing business risk or risks associated with solution design and delivery.
  • Support and lead in the development of internal architecture best practices and people.
  • Build expertise of best-in-class solutions / technology.
  • Work directly with Business resources and Business Analysts to drive technical solutions for business requirements.
  • Lead and drive multiple streams within IT and the business teams in coming to a common understanding of processes and technology solutions to support them.
  • Mentor and lead a team of software engineers which will be accountable for the WAPITI platform and share knowledge across the organization.
  • Maintain in-depth understanding of technical landscape for their capability area.
  • Lead Continuous Improvement (CI) initiatives; consult and share knowledge across the organization with full awareness of industry trends.

About Us

Huggies. Kleenex. Cottonelle. Scott. Kotex. Poise. Depend. Kimberly-Clark Professional. You already know our legendary brands—and so does the rest of the world. In fact, millions of people use Kimberly-Clark products every day. We know these amazing Kimberly-Clark products wouldn’t exist without talented professionals, like you.

At Kimberly-Clark, you’ll be part of the best team committed to driving innovation, growth and impact. We’re founded on more than 150 years of market leadership, and we’re always looking for new and better ways to perform – so there’s your open door of opportunity. It’s all here for you at Kimberly-Clark.

About You

You perform at the highest level possible, and you appreciate a performance culture fueled by authentic caring. You want to be part of a company actively dedicated to sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development.
You love what you do, especially when the work you do makes a difference. At Kimberly-Clark, we’re constantly exploring new ideas on how, when, and where we can best achieve results. When you join our team, you’ll experience Flex That Works: flexible (Hybrid) work arrangements that empower you to have purposeful time in the office and partner with your leader to make flexibility work for both you and the business.

In one of our professional roles, you’ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the center. To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

Who you are?

  • Bachelor's degree; 8+ years of Professional experience of Information Technology experience including working directly with business clients.
  • Mandatory knowledge or experience in robotics integration.
  • Mandatory knowledge of developing reusable interfaces.
  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder WMS Solution.
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP S4 EWM solution.
  • Experience of integration with SAP ECC/S4 ERP is a plus.
  • Verbal and written fluency in English is mandatory.
  • Ability to work in a virtual team which may work across distance (remote), cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines, and may extend outside the K-C organization including suppliers, partners and customers.
  • Please attach your CV in English

Total Benefits

Here are just a few of the benefits you’d enjoy working in this role for Kimberly-Clark.

  • Great support for good health with medical, dental, and vision coverage options with no waiting periods or pre-existing condition restrictions.
  • Access to an on-site fitness center, occupational health nurse, and allowances for high-quality safety equipment.
  • Flexible Savings and spending accounts to maximize health care options and stretch dollars when caring for yourself or dependents.
  • Diverse income protection insurance options to protect yourself and your family in case of illness, injury, or other unexpected events.
  • Additional programs and support to continue your education, adopt a child, relocate, or even find temporary childcare.

To Be Considered

In the meantime, please check out the careers website .

title: Product Owner (PO) Pleno
description:
Product Owner (PO) Pleno

Descrição

Estamos buscando um(a) Product Owner para trabalhar com produtos digitais para se juntar à nossa equipe. Como Product Owner Pleno, você será responsável por definir a estratégia e priorizar o backlog, garantindo que o produto entregue valor máximo para os usuários e para o negócio. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com stakeholders e equipe de desenvolvimento para criar produtos inovadores e de alta qualidade.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a visão do produto, definindo a estratégia de curto e médio prazo e o roadmap do produto.
  • Criar e manter o backlog do produto, assegurando que as histórias de usuário estejam bem definidas, priorizadas e alinhadas com a estratégia do produto.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders de diferentes áreas (negócios, marketing, vendas, suporte, etc.) para entender suas necessidades, coletar feedback e garantir o alinhamento com os objetivos da empresa.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planejamento de sprints, daily meetings, revisões, retrospectivas), garantindo a comunicação eficaz e o alinhamento da equipe.
  • Validar as funcionalidades entregues, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de aceitação, às expectativas dos usuários e aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado e análise da concorrência para identificar tendências, oportunidades e ameaças.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Design de Produto ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência como Product Owner em produtos digitais.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum e Kanban.
  • Habilidade para definir a visão do produto, criar roadmaps e priorizar backlogs.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos (Jira, Trello, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em design thinking e outras metodologias de descoberta de produto.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO, etc.).
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou startups.
  • Conhecimento em áreas específicas do produto (ex: e-commerce, SaaS, mobile).

title: Senior Finance & Accounting Specialist
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Finance & Accounting Specialist to join our Finance team in Brazil and act as a key partner to the Senior Finance Manager. This role is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic and high-growth environment, especially one preparing for regulatory supervision by the Central Bank of Brazil.

This person will take ownership of day-to-day accounting operations while also contributing to local compliance and global reporting, enabling the leadership team to focus on more strategic initiatives.

What You’ll Be Doing

    Report directly to the Sr. Finance Manager in Brazil and serve as her right hand in all local financial operations.

    Prepare the monthly closing process, including journal entries, reconciliations and variance analysis, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data.

    Ensure timely completion of monthly close and reporting activities under tight deadlines, maintaining high accuracy and compliance with internal and external requirements.

    Lead communication with outsourcing accounting firms, to ensure compliance with local tax and accounting regulations.

    Support accounting, tax, internal controls, cost management, accounts payable, and both management and regulatory reporting.

    Prepare financial statements for internal use, external audits, and regulatory bodies.

    Execute AP and ensure all operating expenses are accurately recorded and paid in accordance with internal policies.

    Manage the issuance of electronic invoices for all company operations, ensuring accuracy and compliance with local tax requirements.

    Support the implementation and maintenance of strong internal controls over financial reporting.

    Identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities in financial operations and reporting.

    Collaborate with international and multicultural teams across different time zones.

What We Look For In You

    Bachelor's degree in Accounting.

    6+ years of relevant experience in accounting roles, ideally in the financial services, fintech, or crypto sectors.

    Strong knowledge of IFRS standards and experience with corporate income tax (IRPJ/CSLL). Indirect tax knowledge (VAT) is a plus.

    Demonstrated experience with intercompany reconciliations and exposure to transfer pricing concepts (a strong plus).

    Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ownership mentality.

    Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment with a hands-on and autonomous work style.

    Proven ability to deliver high-quality work within deadlines and under pressure, especially during monthly and quarterly close cycles.

    Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (mandatory).

    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (including pivot tables, lookups, and dynamic dashboards); experience with Power Query is a strong plus.

Nice to Haves

    Previous experience in a regulated entity, especially one overseen by the Brazilian Central Bank.

    Prior work in the crypto, blockchain, or digital assets space.

    Big Four background or experience with external audits.

    Experience with Oracle NetSuite or similar ERPs.

    Advanced degree or relevant professional certification (e.g., MBA, CPA).

    Experience working across time zones and in cross-cultural teams.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events

description:
MISSÃO

Responsável por monitorar, inspecionar e propor medidas para corrigir ou melhorar os processos finais, para atender aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos pela empresa.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Inspecionar e propor mensalmente medidas para corrigir ou melhorar a prestação de serviço e processos, para atender aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e acordados com os clientes;
  2. Realizar anualmente auditorias e acompanhamento de avaliação nas áreas, apontando melhorias nos processos;
  3. Desenvolver diariamente ações educativas para melhoria no fluxo de trabalho;
  4. Organizar diariamente os documentos relacionados às áreas da empresa, analisando os relatórios de não conformidades, para recomendar medidas de prevenção e controle;
  5. Controlar diariamente as perdas de processos da prestação de serviços, determinando e analisando as causas, para estabelecer o plano de ação preventivo e corretivo;
  6. Desenvolver e testar diariamente sistemas, processos e métodos produtivos, para melhorar a prestação de serviço da empresa;

REQUISITOS

  1. Ensino superior completo: Gestão de Qualidade ou Administração ou áreas relacionadas;
  2. Conhecimento em procedimentos do ramo de transporte coletivo;
  3. Habilidade com Pacote Office e Power BI;
  4. CNH B;
  5. Disponibilidade para viagens;

Obs: Essa oportunidade é para candidatos que tenham total disponibilidade para atuar no estado do MS realizando viagens diárias/semanais nas garagens SERTRAN.

QUEM SOMOS

A SERTRAN nasceu vocacionada para o transporte de pessoas. Desde quando foi fundada, a companhia acumula experiência e conhecimento no transporte de passageiros. Desde sua fundação, em 1996 até na data de hoje foram dedicados ao transporte de milhões de pessoas, o que a transformou em uma especialista em transportar vidas.

No início de sua fundação, a Sertran possuía uma pequena garagem na rua Coronel Francisco Schmidt, em Sertãozinho/SP, onde operava apenas 12 veículos, com poucos colaboradores, e um sonho a ser concretizado. Em pouco mais de duas décadas, com muito empenho de todos seus colaboradores diretos e controladores, a empresa multiplicou a sua frota em mais de 108 vezes e ampliou a sua capacidade operacional para atender diversos setores produtivos da sociedade.

Atualmente, são cerca de 1300 veículos, incluindo ônibus rodoviários, ônibus agrícola, micro-ônibus e vans, todos dedicados ao transporte de pessoas. Possui mais de 2.700 colaboradores diretos, alocados em diversos estados do país.

title: Data Product Manager - Environmental, Social and Governance
description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

Together with analytics team leaders you will support our business with excellent data models to uncover trends that can drive long-term business results.

How you will contribute:

  • Drive the end-to-end delivery of data products including design, delivery, and governance within Mondelez following established product management practices.

  • Advocate for and carefully manage product and project funding including budgeting, headcount needs, and other costs.

  • Bridge conversations between ESG stakeholders and technical teams using business domain knowledge and technical expertise.

  • Own end-to-end data governance for ESG data maintaining consistent data quality, timeliness, and discoverability.

  • Identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, resilience, and innovation in Mondelez’ data landscape.

  • Prioritize development items according to deadlines, business context, and technical need.

What you will bring:

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in data and analytics – including data warehousing, analyzing and visualizing data, SQL, critical thinking and basic understanding of Machine Learning.

  • BUSINESS ACUMEN coupled with familiarity with sustainability or supply chain in consumer goods or manufacturing contexts.

  • LEADERSHIP SKILLS including a natural ability to make things happen around you while managing project ambiguity, complexity and interdependencies in a well-organized and structured way.

  • GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to identify/execute opportunities and leverage technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

  • CLOUD EXPERIENCE with data solutions like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • DESIGN and data visualization experience.

  • INTEGRITY and sound judgement in all decisions and interactions aligned with our values and policies and external regulations.

More about this role:

We are aware of our role as transformation agents to generate positive change, so diversity, equity and inclusion are one of our priorities. We believe in breaking down stereotypes and barriers to ensure the representation of society within our company. And for that, we have a Diversity Committee that operates on four fronts: People with disabilities (PCD), Ethnic-Racial, Women, and LGBTQIAP+, in addition to being part of MOVER – Movimento pela Equidade Racial.

As a product manager for data and analytics ESG, you will use a mix of technical skill and business acumen to help Mondelez build data and analytics products to support our commitments to sustainability and transparency. You'll work cross-functionally to capture, analyze, and translate complex data into actionable insights that drive business decisions, support our sustainability commitments and reporting. The products you drive will serve decision makers across all of Mondelez, by improving our measurement and insight using Mondelez’ data. Your contribution will foster the delivery of timely, relevant, and accurate insight to teams that need it. Your skills and experience will connect business leaders to data and analytics solutions throughout Mondelez.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

Required Experience:

6+ years of progressive leadership experience in a data and analytics function;

4+ years of product ownership or leadership in the development of data and analytical products;

Experience with SAP or other ERP data in a matrixed environment.

Preferred Experience:

Direct experience in sustainability and/or manufacturing Supply Chain is a plus.

Management consulting always a plus.

Travel requirements:

Limited travel up to 20% of time.

Mondelez International is attentive to the future of work and values the well-being of our people, seeking to provide the best experiences. Therefore, some of our administrative vacancies are eligible for the hybrid model, allowing remote work on certain days of the week.

No Relocation support available.

Business Unit Summary:

Mondelēz Brasil is Mondelēz International’s fourth largest operation in the world, with approximately 7,500 employees proudly producing, selling and distributing some of the most beloved brands of chewing gum, candies, powdered beverages, cream cheeses, chocolates, cookies and desserts in Brazil. We make the Brazilians’ favorite products such as Bis, Lacta, Oreo, Club Social, Sonho de Valsa, Trakinas, Trident, Halls, Royal, Tang and many others. We are truly part of the lives of Brazilians: You can find our mouth-watering products in more than 700,000 points of sale and we are present in more than 92% of Brazilian homes. Our factories are located in Vitória de Santo Antão, in the state of Pernambuco, and Curitiba, in the state of Paraná. We are also home to one of the company's 11 technology centers around the world, responsible for research and development, so we can continue to create new and innovative products, offering the right snack for the right time, done in the right way.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The Role:

The Content Production Manager works closely with the client’s Image Producer and the agency Content Studio to execute and create localized screens for websites and marketing materials, including reviewing content for cultural appropriateness in Spanish. The role also supports the language creative team with content assets and photography versions. The manager collaborates with various teams to select content, coordinate projects, and ensure timely delivery of localized assets across multiple platforms, including apps, media, and entertainment content.

  1. Follow localization strategies from the client’s Image Producer and coordinate with functional teams to meet deadlines.

  4. Gather assets, create briefs for content creation, and manage asset requests from Geo Content Studio.
  5. Develop proficiency in iOS & OS software and understand client products deeply.
  6. Request photo retouching and manage image approvals.
  7. Fulfill image requests and communicate with worldwide teams for asset transfers.
  8. Utilize third-party assets with Business Affairs and transfer launch assets to long-term digital systems.
  9. Manage asset databases and organize archives.
  10. Train new team members and understand language nuances for localization needs.
  11. Track and manage content localization throughout production to ensure on-time delivery.
  12. Oversee final asset staging, QC, and delivery, and collaborate on job distribution planning.

Requirements:

  • At least 4 years’ experience in graphic production, photo producing, or project management at a design firm, ad agency, or interactive shop.
  • Creative, flexible, tech-savvy, and solutions-oriented, with proficiency in Adobe Photoshop.
  • Proficiency in iOS and OS software is essential.
  • Knowledge of image reproduction needs for web, POS, motion graphics, and email marketing.
  • Attention to detail, accuracy, and excellent memory.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, demanding environment, with flexibility for extended hours and weekends.
  • Excellent written and verbal skills in English and Spanish.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a respectful culture where everyone has equal opportunities for growth. For accessibility, contact for alternative formats.

description:
Seu bem-estar importa. Junte-se a uma empresa que se importa também.

Fundada em 2012 e sediada em Nova York, nossa empresa tem uma equipe crescente em 11 países. No Wellhub, você tem a oportunidade de construir a sua carreira em uma empresa de tecnologia de alto crescimento, que coloca o bem-estar como base da sua cultura e, além disso, contribui para fazer de toda empresa uma empresa de bem-estar.

*Grande novidade: Gympass agora é Wellhub!

Estamos felizes em anunciar nossa mudança de marca para Wellhub, um marco significativo na nossa jornada. Essa transformação reflete nossa evolução de “passe para academias” para uma solução ampla de bem-estar para colaboradores. Com nossa identidade atualizada, estamos prontos para embarcar em um capítulo novo e empolgante de crescimento e expansão. Estamos elevando nossa oferta, incluindo uma experiência completamente nova em nosso app e expansão da rede de nossos parceiros de bem-estar. Veja mais sobre isso aqui.

Estamos contratando uma pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade Bilíngue para o nosso time de CX em São Paulo!

Como pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade, você será referência para nossos parceiros de CX, atuando como uma pessoa consultora confiável e estratégica, com foco em garantir a padronização global dos processos de qualidade e impulsionar melhorias contínuas na experiência do cliente.

Buscamos alguém com forte capacidade analítica e domínio avançado em dados, capaz de transformar informações em ações relevantes. É essencial ter experiência com criação de relatórios, análise de KPIs, uso de dashboards e ferramentas como Excel avançado, Tableau, Power BI ou similares, além de uma comunicação clara e profissional para lidar com stakeholders internos, externos e parceiros BPO.

  • Realizar auditorias de qualidade, monitoramento e análise de dados em várias regiões, canais e equipes (tribos) como especialista na área, para identificar erros críticos e oportunidades de melhoria contínua (em políticas, processos, desempenho de agentes, sistemas e produtos).
  • Lidere uma equipe de 1 ou 2 membros, garantindo o desempenho e o desenvolvimento deles.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre mudanças nos fluxos de trabalho, diretrizes operacionais e políticas.
  • Conduzir análises de dados para identificar causas raiz, detectar tendências e problemas, buscando sempre a precisão.
  • Realizar análises aprofundadas complexas, interpretando dados por meio de dashboards e relatórios, com domínio de ferramentas como Excel avançado, Tableau, Power BI ou similares, a fim de identificar padrões e propor planos de ação eficazes com mínima supervisão e, frequentemente, de forma independente.
  • Fornecer recomendações sobre as melhores alavancas para melhorar a Qualidade, considerando o impacto potencial em métricas-chave, custos, etc.
  • Acompanhar a eficácia dos planos de ação e reportar os resultados.
  • Organizar e liderar sessões de calibração com a equipe interna e também com o nosso BPO (parceiro terceirizado).
  • Atuar como elo de ligação com a equipe de treinamento, fornecendo insumos com base nas lacunas identificadas.
  • Executar projetos complexos e interfuncionais com diferentes grupos de trabalho, antecipando mudanças de direção e escopo.
  • Executar outras atividades conforme designado
  • Viva a missão: inspire e empodere Wellhubbers ao priorizar seu próprio bem-estar e de seus colegas. Faça parte de um ambiente de apoio, onde todas as pessoas se sentem à vontade para cuidar de si mesmas, tirar folgas e encontrar um equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal.

Aqui, a sua autonomia vai se transformar em um impacto duradouro no negócio e no mundo. Nossa cultura baseada em confiança, flexibilidade e integridade torna tudo isso possível todos os dias. title: Cyber Security Incident handler
description:
Please apply with an English CV.

We are looking for a SOC Incident Handler

The SOC Incident Handler is responsible for resolving incidents identified by SOC analysts. The core function is containing and mitigating suspected harmful cyber events by focusing the appropriate resources to address incidents, minimize potential damage, and recover quickly. This position involves chasing/following-up progress, actively communicating with operations and business units regarding the incident and actions taken throughout its lifecycle, and leveraging SOC analysts to support investigations.

This role is part of the Verisure SOC, providing Incident Response support for a global company spanning from Finland to Argentina. Responsibilities include daily incident handling and anticipating future events.

Documentation tasks include creating runbooks, strengthening procedures, and communication actions as part of Incident Response. Coordinating multi-team frameworks to improve IR processes and procedures is also central.

Primary responsibilities include:

  1. Planning, managing, coordinating, and communicating to contain and mitigate incidents.
  2. Working closely with regional IT Operations and teammates to resolve cybersecurity and privacy incidents promptly; escalating unresolved incidents as needed.
  3. Applying knowledge and experience with the IR lifecycle.
  4. Prioritizing incidents based on criticality; distinguishing between misconfigurations and events that could escalate.
  5. Providing ongoing coordination, direction, and leadership for all incidents raised by SOC.
  6. Building rapport with SOC analysts to gather investigative analysis and understand incidents.
  7. Developing trusted communication with key stakeholders across multiple countries.
  8. Maintaining high confidence with the SOC Manager.
  9. Communicating incident status clearly and effectively.
  10. Handling AV alerts on endpoints and servers.
  11. Using outlined policies to guide security practices and identifying gaps for improvement.
  12. Reading VM reports to identify affected assets based on Threat Intelligence reports.
  13. Documenting all team activities, especially containment and recovery, and creating reliable incident timelines.
  14. Maintaining high standards of best practices and professionalism within the SOC team.
  15. Exhibiting excellent writing and presentation skills.

Secondary responsibilities include:

  1. Recommending security improvements to enhance internal protection.
  2. Assisting with InfoSec projects as needed.
  3. Applying best practice standards to security tools to minimize infrastructure harm.
  4. Providing coverage for teammates.
  5. Acting as the main point for incident escalation during major incidents.

Essential skills & experience:

  1. Extensive experience in cyber operations, including monitoring, incident response, threat detection, and threat intelligence.
  2. Proficiency in English and Portuguese.
  3. SIEM experience.
  4. Knowledge of ISO27001, CIS Benchmarks, NIST.
  5. Experience with ticketing systems and procedure lifecycle management.
  6. Familiarity with the Mitre Attack Framework.
  7. Relevant degree or equivalent industry experience.
  8. Understanding of legal obligations and legislation such as GDPR.
  9. Excellent communication and formal report writing skills.
  10. Ability to conduct independent research.
  11. Security awareness and international work experience within a global team.
  12. Willingness to perform other essential duties as required.

Desirable skills & experience:

  1. Incident Handler certifications such as GCIH, ECIH, CySA+, CREST, CISSP.
  2. ITIL certification.
  3. Experience with Splunk, Linux, Windows, scripting, memory forensics, firewall traffic analysis, Wireshark, penetration testing, vulnerability tools, ForeScout, and NAC.

Verisure is a global provider of monitored security solutions, operating in 17 countries. We are an innovative, fast-paced company committed to protecting people and saving lives.

We are an equal opportunity employer, welcoming applicants from diverse backgrounds, with offices and colleagues across multiple countries.

Sobre nós
A Rentbrella é a líder global em compartilhamento de guarda-chuvas , com presença em países como Brasil, Estados Unidos e Reino Unido. Com mais de 1.300 estações e 150 mil guarda-chuvas, a empresa revolucionou a mobilidade urbana e se tornou parceira de grandes corporações, como Petrobras, Shopee, Itaú, Mercado Livre , entre outras.
Junte-se ao time que está redefinindo a forma como as empresas se conectam com as pessoas!
Nossos valores

title: Software Engineer, Frontend - Brazil
description:
At DoorDash, we’re on a mission to empower local economies — and that mission drives everything we do. What started as food delivery has evolved into a technology and logistics platform designed to help people access anything in their city, from meals to everyday essentials. We’re building the future of local commerce, and we’re looking for team members excited to be part of that journey.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well-being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

About the Team

The 1P Integrations Team is at the forefront of building and scaling a comprehensive suite of first-party eCommerce solutions. These include Online Ordering (websites, apps, kiosks), white-label logistics (Drive On Demand), customer support solutions, corporate ordering, merchant loyalty and rewards, and strategic marketplace partnership integrations. As part of a larger Platform Services organization, this team is poised to make a significant impact by helping hundreds of thousands of merchants across the Americas grow their businesses and improve their working lives in one of the country’s largest industry sectors.

About the Role

Frontend Engineers at DoorDash help design and build beautiful, intuitive user interfaces for our web applications to create the best delivery experience possible. Product focused Engineers work at the intersection of product and infrastructure to solve key business problems with elegant technical solutions. You’ll work with both technical and business teams to build features that keep our users top of mind.

This role is hybrid with some in-office time expected and will report to an Engineering Manager.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Become a product owner for one of our client facing applications.
  • Write robust, highly tested, well-crafted code that you can be proud of.
  • Fight for the best customer experience through technical and product decisions.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • B.S., M.S. or PhD in relevant field
  • 5+ years of industry experience
  • Experience architecting large-scale frontend applications
  • Mastery of the foundations of the web: vanilla JS, HTML5, CSS3
  • Deep understanding of REST principles and experience working with and implementing backend APIs
  • Experience with React/Redux, or similar frameworks
  • Experience with documentation, unit and integration testing

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. description:
Scala Engineer - Relocate to Portugal *VISA Sponsorship Provided*

A global SaaS leader for seamless digital document workflows, Nitro offers a suite of solutions for PDF, eSigning, identity verification and analytics supported by a best-in-class customer success and change management team. With more than 3 million licensed users and 13,000+ business customers across 157 countries, we serve 67% of the Fortune 500.

How We Work:

We aim to create an environment where talented individuals are empowered to excel. How we collaborate, innovate, and engage with one another is important to us. Our work is driven by 5 key principles:

  • One team, One mission: Our collective dedication to Nitro's mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.
  • Own it: We take full ownership of our actions and decisions. We empower one another to lead with confidence, creativity, and a solutions-focused mindset.
  • Accountable to our customers: We are dedicated to our customers and take our commitments seriously. We do what we say we are going to do.
  • Excellence in execution: Driven by passion and precision, we exemplify excellence in our delivery with innovative, top-quality results.
  • Be bold, fail fast, learn faster: We learn as we grow, dare to try, and bravely question. We are not chasing perfection but forever iterating towards it.

These guiding values shape our approach to work, fostering a culture where everyone is inspired to contribute their best.

The Role:

We are looking for a backend engineer to join our team responsible for the acquisition and renewal stages of the customer journey. The successful candidate will work closely with Business Stakeholders to increase conversion and maximize revenue while improving the experience our customers have as they trial our software, purchase, renew and manage their Nitro subscriptions.

What you’ll be doing:

You will join the existing team and collaborate on delivering feature, security, scalability and resiliency enhancements to our existing Scala code base. You will contribute to the design of new features and work cross-functionally with other Nitro Engineering teams to support the exciting enhancements coming to the Nitro cloud product suite.

What we’re looking for:

  • JVM-based development and deployment experience.
  • Strong knowledge of, and professional development experience with a JVM based language, preferably Scala.
  • Experience building SaaS products, particularly in the AWS cloud.
  • Knowledge of event-driven concepts and architectures.
  • Familiarity with continuous development and deployment practices.
  • Ability to drive project delivery from early ideation through to production deployment.
  • Commitment to software quality through clean code, testing and verification.
  • Open and transparent communicator as comfortable with in-person collaboration as with solo focus.

Why Nitro?

Along with our regular benefits and programs (including health, dental, vision, and retirement as standard), we are also very proud to offer a few additional initiatives to future Nitronauts:

Hybrid Work: Our team embraces the hybrid work model, appreciating its blend of flexibility and structure. We combine three days of in-person collaboration at our global offices in Toronto, Dublin, Antwerp, Porto, and Melbourne with the convenience of two days of remote work each week.

Benefits: Nitro provides all employees with a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, dental and vision coverage, and wellness perks. We also offer pension/401k matching, along with many other country-specific benefits.

Nitro strongly encourages applications from everyone regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. We provide an accessible candidate experience and invite you to request any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond.

description:
Do you want to help our customers adopt cutting-edge cloud computing technology, solve the biggest of 'big data' problems, work with Internet-scale distributed systems, and see the impact of your work with happy and successful customers?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth, business knowledge, and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner with customers and several AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around cloud-based solutions and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within organizations ranging from new start-ups to large enterprise customers. Connecting technology with measurable business value is critical to this role.

Here are some qualities we are looking for:

  1. Be great fun to work with. At AWS, we have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history.” You will love what you do and know how to make work fun. Be dynamic, creative, and willing to take on challenges to make a big impact.
  2. Enjoy working with diverse customers. You should have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a range of customers from small businesses to large enterprises. Expect to design flexible, scalable solutions and tackle complex challenges in large-scale computing.
  3. Have a strong understanding of computing solutions. Experience in the computing industry is preferred. Keep your technical skills sharp, develop new skills, and help update architectural collateral to ensure customers can build world-class solutions on AWS.

Key job responsibilities include:

  1. Building a solid knowledge foundation of AWS cloud services and the cloud ecosystem.
  2. Educating customers of all sizes about AWS's value proposition.
  3. Assisting with training sessions for current and prospective AWS users.
  4. Collaborating with experienced solutions architects to share best practices within the AWS community.
  5. Serving as a technical liaison among customers, engineering teams, and support.

Qualifications include:

  • Experience with programming languages such as Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++.
  • Experience with networking fundamentals, security, storage, databases (relational or NoSQL), and operating systems (Unix, Linux, Windows).
  • Experience implementing cloud-based solutions.
  • Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting.
  • Knowledge in software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, or data & analytics.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services like EC2, EBS, and S3, and experience architecting solutions on AWS.
  • Solution-selling methodologies experience.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner and AWS Solutions Architect Associate certifications are preferred; other cloud certifications are also welcome.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

Descrição da empresa

A SGS é uma Multinacional Suiça, líder mundial em Inspeção, Verificação, Testes e Certificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com 99.600 colaboradores no mundo, contamos com 2.650 escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Se você tem como valores, integridade, espírito empreendedor e inovação, o seu lugar é aqui! Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

AtkinsRéalis es uno de los grupos de ingeniería nuclear del sector privado más grandes de Canadá. Hemos estado proporcionando una amplia gama de servicios a la industria nuclear en Canadá y en todo el mundo durante más de 60 años. Estamos orgullosos de ser los guardianes de la tecnología nuclear CANDU canadiense.

AtkinsRéalis está buscando Analistas de Seguridad PSA para ser parte de nuestro equipo en el apoyo al diseño de nuevas plantas de energía nuclear y la operación y renovación de las plantas de energía nuclear CANDU existentes. El analista senior de PSA trabajará con otros miembros junior y senior del personal para desarrollar y aplicar metodologías de análisis avanzadas para realizar PSAs y otros análisis de seguridad relacionados con PSA para plantas existentes, en renovación y nuevas construcciones. Estos incluyen temas relacionados con la identificación de peligros, PSA de Nivel 1, PSA de Nivel 2, PSA de Nivel 3, evaluaciones de seguridad sísmica, de inundación y/o de incendio, análisis de modos de falla y efectos, eventos internos y externos. También se espera que los candidatos puedan desarrollar material de capacitación en PSA y revisar documentos de PSA.

Ubicación – Buenos Aires, Argentina

Tu rol dentro del equipo:

  • Supervisar el trabajo del personal en un entorno multidisciplinario y ser responsable de la calidad del trabajo realizado.

¿Por qué elegir AtkinsRéalis como empleador? Porque ofrecemos:

  • Capacidad para trabajar de cerca y de manera efectiva con los clientes en una relación cliente/consultor.
  • Capacidad para trabajar bien bajo presión y ser flexible, es decir, debe ser capaz de realizar asignaciones de trabajo variadas de manera efectiva y responder rápidamente a las necesidades cambiantes del proyecto.
  • Conocimiento del análisis de accidentes graves y las directrices de gestión de accidentes graves.
  • Habilidades de liderazgo comprobadas, proporcionando orientación técnica para asistir y supervisar a los analistas.
  • Capacidad para mostrar iniciativa mientras se trabaja en un entorno de equipo.
  • Capacidad para trabajar con presupuesto y cronograma.
  • Debe estar dispuesto a viajar ocasionalmente para participar en recorridos, reuniones y talleres.
  • Compromiso total con el trabajo en un entorno de QA formal.
  • Ventajas: Competencia en la suite de códigos de computadora CAFTA, CFAST y RiskSpectrum. La experiencia en actividades de licencia, comprensión del diseño de reactores de agua ligera y PSAs.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita en inglés.

¿Estás listo para este desafío? Aplica hoy y únete a nuestro equipo para ayudar a diseñar un mejor futuro para nuestro planeta y su gente. En AtkinsRéalis, buscamos contratar a personas con diversas características, antecedentes y perspectivas. title: Senior Portfolio Analyst
description:
